name: FM-1 Again
author: PolarPatch
tagline: warm, chopped, pumping: the FM-1 made again
description: Warm, emotional, rhythmic electronic music made again on the FM-1: chopped and pitched voices and everyday sounds, soft piano chords, a sidechain pump, garage and house grooves, build-ups and drops.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments); modules from Arctic Scream p0larpatch.
